experiment_data.hypothesis: Min-K% Prob (Shi et al. 2024) continuous membership-inference scores, when calibrated to 4-class ordinal depth via equal-width/CORAL/threshold methods, achieve near-chance accuracy (30-35%) on 9-cell atlas. Establishes that binary detection scores lack ordinal depth resolution. Rebuttal ammunition against "did you test Min-K% for ordinal?"
experiment_data.notes: Results extracted from gpu-6000pro-2. 9/9 cells complete. Previously ran on gpu-6000pro-2 (not westd-48862). All methods near chance (25%): methodA ~24-25%, methodC ~24-25%, methodB best at 29-33% but still far from useful. Hypothesis confirmed.

metrics.verdict: methodA/C at chance (~25%). methodB slightly above chance (29-33%) but far from useful. Confirms Min-K% cannot do ordinal depth classification.
